create_bullet_client: create a BulletClient connection in DIRECT or GUI mode for PyBullet simulation
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model file into the PyBullet simulation environment
join_two_urdf_models: join two URDF models together with configurable joint pivot positions and orientations
save_combined_urdf: save the edited or combined URDF robot description to a file on disk
create_multibody_in_gui: create a multi-body from a UrdfEditor and render it in a GUI client
